name: Cridhe
description: Plane on which the Parting occurred.

description_citations.text: "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aylith and Nazir recite the Awakening Ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree and ending the fighting.
timeline.quote: a new sapling Clan Tree took root, restoring balance to the plane

citation.text: "Aylith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Haen is chosen as Keeper of the Tree and sworn to protect it; Nohr grows jealous.
timeline.quote: Nohr grew jealous at his friend's new status.

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malvos gives Nohr Soulslayer and Nohr swears to break the tree to gain planeswalkerhood.
timeline.quote: Nohr swore to break the tree to gain planeswalkerhood .

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nohr splits the Clan Tree despite Haen's protests, causing the Parting and killing the tree.
timeline.quote: Despite Haen's heavy protesting, Nohr split the tree, causing Haen to fall out of its branches to the ground

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Haen sleeps frozen in time, then wakes three weeks later with fire in his fingers and reawakens the tree's remnants with a new ritual.
timeline.quote: Haen woke up and had a fire in his fingers

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nazir assists the Awakening Ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree and ending his reign.
timeline.quote: Nazir assisted in performing the Awakening Ritual alongside Aylith, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nohr confronts Haen and destroys the Clan Tree with Soulslayer, breaking the sword tip into his own chest.
timeline.quote: When Haen refuses to reveal the mana line, Nohr lashes out at the tree with the sword, sending out a freezing beam that causes the Clan Tree to explode into icy chunks.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aylith is nearly devoured by a shroud on the march.
timeline.quote: On the march to Inys Nohr, Aylith is nearly devoured by a shroud

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The capture of Aylith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aylith heals Nazir's madness; they recite the ritual and the Clan Tree is mended.
timeline.quote: A small sapling Clan Tree arises and the plane's balance is restored.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malvos is consumed by a shroud disguised as a tent after Tempé visits him.
timeline.quote: which lulls him to sleep with a magical song and then collapses upon him, consuming him.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The death of Malvos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crephas engineers the Albions with an altered fungus to work his coal mines, and they become addicted and turn blue.
timeline.quote: He served the altered fungus to his best soldiers, increasing their capacity for work and their ability to see in near darkness.

citation.text: "Human", section "Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crephas chooses to enslave the Mirkalbions, binding them to himself.
timeline.quote: He chose to enslave them, binding them to himself.

citation.text: "Human", section "Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malvos steals Tempé's mana as payment and is exiled to Cridhe, marked with snake tattoos that would kill him if he thought of touching mana.
timeline.quote: Malvos stole Tempé's mana as payment for his services.

citation.text: "Malvos", section "Imprisonment on Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Cridhe Malvos discovers the hidden Clan Tree and plans to make someone a planeswalker with its mana.
timeline.quote: he found an enormous source of mana hidden even from Planeswalkers' eyes

citation.text: "Malvos", section "Imprisonment on Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malvos gives Nohr the sword Soulslayer; the magical rays miss the mana line and destroy the Clan Tree, causing the Parting.
timeline.quote: the Clan Tree was destroyed, causing the Parting

citation.text: "Malvos", section "Imprisonment on Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crippled after the Mending, Malvos is visited by Tempé, tells her what he knows, and is devoured by a hungry shroud.
timeline.quote: collapsing around him, devouring him whole

citation.text: "Malvos", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aylith heals Nazir of his madness and the Clan Tree is mended.
timeline.quote: witnessing the return of sunlight and warmth to the land

citation.text: "Lorris", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi recruits Wrenn on Cridhe to fight the Phyrexians; the group gathers on Dominaria and settles in Urza's Tower.
timeline.quote: Wrenn was recruited by Teferi to join the fight against the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Wrenn", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Instigated by Malvos, Nohr destroys the Clan Tree trying to become a planeswalker; the isle splits in two and Nohr and his descendants are cursed with madness.
timeline.quote: the wizard Nohr destroyed the tree trying to become a planeswalker

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Parting, clouds obscure the sun and the climate collapses; crops wither and Nohrland dies.
timeline.quote: Clouds immediately obscured the sun, creating a permanent daily twilight and nightly darkness.

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Year 520, Aylith and Nazir mend the Clan Tree and the seasons return to normal.
timeline.quote: Keeper Aylith and Felonarch Nazir descendants of Haen and Nohr, mended the Clan Tree .

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aylith breaks the curse on Nazir and together they recreate the Clan Tree from the last acorn, fulfilling Haen's prophecy.
timeline.quote: the Keeper Aylith used her powers to break the curse on Nazir .

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nazir has a prophetic vision of what the plane will look like in 1000 years.
timeline.quote: the healed wizard Nazir had a prophetic vision of what the plane would look like 1000 years in the future

citation.text: "Cridhe", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arn resolves to seek an alliance with the Far Clans and pleads for their aid.
timeline.storyline: Magic: The Gathering - Wilds of Eldraine / Cridhe (Keeper novel)
timeline.quote: He resolved to seek an alliance with the Far clans

citation.text: "Arn", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Morkin misleads Arn into an icy marsh; Feryar rescues him, and he succeeds in allying the clans.
timeline.storyline: Magic: The Gathering - Wilds of Eldraine / Cridhe (Keeper novel)
timeline.quote: Arn was rescued at the last moment by Feryar, who guided him back to safety.

citation.text: "Arn", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aylith and the former Felonarch recite the spring ritual, mending the Clan Tree.
timeline.storyline: Magic: The Gathering - Wilds of Eldraine / Cridhe (Keeper novel)
timeline.quote: who together recited the spring ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree

citation.text: "Arn", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arn becomes Keeper of the new Clan Tree and settles in Inys Haen.
timeline.storyline: Magic: The Gathering - Wilds of Eldraine / Cridhe (Keeper novel)
timeline.quote: Arn took the mantle of the Keeper upon himself.

citation.text: "Arn", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aylith and Nazir recited the Awakening Ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree.
timeline.quote: Reciting the ancient Awakening Ritual, they channeled the magic of the land and restored balance to the world

citation.text: "Inys Haen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arn became the new Keeper as the Clan Tree grew for 1000 years.
timeline.quote: With the freed slave Arn as its new Keeper

citation.text: "Inys Haen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nohr and his followers found Inys Nohr after the Parting; it becomes an isolated stronghold cursed with perpetual winter after the Clan Tree is destroyed.
timeline.quote: Founded by Nohr and his followers after the Parting

citation.text: "Inys Nohr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taken by the Nohrish, Jedhian heals Malvos with his last magic, destroying Soulslayer and sealing his fate within Cridhe.
timeline.quote: he was forced to heal Malvos using the last of his magic

citation.text: "Jedhian", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jedhian witnesses the Awakening Ritual that mends the Clan Tree and ends the war.
timeline.quote: Jedhian witnessed the Awakening Ritual that restored balance to the land

citation.text: "Jedhian", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arn, betrayed and left to die, is rescued by Feryar and brings the Far Clans into battle at the spring equinox.
timeline.quote: he returned just in time to bring the clans into the battle

citation.text: "Mending of the Clan Tree", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aylith ambushes Nazir but spares him, entering his soul and healing him of madness and mutations.
timeline.quote: healing him of the madness, pain, and mutations

citation.text: "Mending of the Clan Tree", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aylith and Nazir perform the Awakening Ritual, the ice melts and a Clan Tree sapling sprouts.
timeline.quote: a small sapling pushed through the soil

citation.text: "Mending of the Clan Tree", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Seeing the reborn Clan Tree, the armies halt and lay down arms.
timeline.quote: the armies laid down their weapons

citation.text: "Mending of the Clan Tree", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tempé visits Malvos, who cannot give the knowledge she seeks, and leaves him to be devoured by a shroud.
timeline.quote: she left him to his fate

citation.text: "Mending of the Clan Tree", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nohr and Haen are reunited.
timeline.quote: were finally reunited

citation.text: "Mending of the Clan Tree", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malvos manipulated Nohr into performing a ritual upon the Clan Tree.
timeline.quote: manipulated Nohr into performing a ritual upon the Clan Tree of Cridhe

citation.text: "The Parting", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Raphos tried to stop the ritual and was killed by Nohr wielding Malvos's sword.
timeline.quote: The blacksmith Raphos attempted to stop the ritual and was killed by Nohr

citation.text: "The Parting", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The ritual killed the Clan Tree, fulfilling the Maker's curse and splitting the land in two.
timeline.quote: the land split in two, physically and spiritually dividing the people of the plane

citation.text: "The Parting", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nohr's descendants were afflicted with madness and the Long Winter followed.
timeline.quote: Those descended from Nohr were afflicted with madness

citation.text: "The Parting", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
